title: Staying at Anand to build the cooperative
statement: A petroleum engineer awaiting a scholarship, Kurien was posted to a dusty government creamery at Anand and chose to stay to help Tribhuvandas Patel's farmer cooperative rather than leave for his intended career.
outcome: That stay built the Kaira District Cooperative — Amul — and the institutional architecture of the White Revolution.

title: Operation Flood — the White Revolution at national scale
statement: Kurien designed and led Operation Flood, using donated European skim-milk-powder monetization to build a national dairy grid of village cooperatives.
outcome: Over 26 years India went from milk-deficient to the world's largest milk producer; the Anand Pattern was replicated in oilseeds and fruit and remains the world's largest agricultural-development program by livelihoods touched.

title: Resisting the multinationals in the Bombay milk market
statement: When Polson and the multinationals fought the cooperative's entry into Bombay, Kurien fought the dairy-interest politics until Prime Minister Shastri toured Anand and sided with the farmers.
outcome: The victory gave the cooperative metropolitan market access and produced the Amul girl ad campaign — the world's longest-running outdoor advertising — built on the dairy-politics story.
